feature: COUNT aggregation with implicit GROUP BY over a one-hop pattern

scenarios.name: count of pg_node neighbors per hub
scenarios.query: MATCH (h:pg_hub)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n:pg_node) RETURN h.entity_id AS hub_id, COUNT(n) AS neighbor_count

scenarios.name: COUNT over a relationship omits zero-degree nodes
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n) RETURN h.entity_id AS source_id, COUNT(n) AS out_degree
